text:
QUOTE: "**Data:** call `index(action='refresh')`." and "**Code:** only a client restart helps. Data is read live per call, so the query tools are current. Only the process's logic is old."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer gives a different remedy for each axis (a refresh for data, a client restart for code) and says a rebuild cannot clear the newer-schema and code axes. It never says outright that this is why one flag wasn't enough, but the different-remedies substance is there.
